data.summary: Secondary report by Opus 5.5 (presented as Claude) on a hunt for AI agents on Tor: relay census, Synapolis city, TV#### flood, Distill on Stellar, MoltBunker, Toro, Colony and musebook boards. Linguist: 94 claims (OBSERVED 7, REPORTED 81, INFERENCE 6). Adversarial review: KILL 6, DOWNGRADE 81, STAND 7. This batch ingests 88 claims (7 STAND + 81 DOWNGRADED with exact caveats) and excludes the 6 KILLED claims entirely.
